_comment: Single source of truth for the client's HTTP security headers (QA DEF-010). Served in production by vercel.json and locally by `vite preview` (vite.config.js). qa/05-unit/unit/clientSecurityHeaders.test.js fails if vercel.json drifts from this file. %API_ORIGIN% is the backend: productionApiOrigin in production, http://localhost:5000 locally. If the API moves to a custom domain, change productionApiOrigin AND vercel.json.
